notes: needs_ruling: «ورووا بهذا الإسناد عن النبي ... أنه قال إذا زنت الأمة فاجلدوها» is a second saying with its own isnad; the Shibl b. Khalid isnad and the Malik, Ma'mar and Sufyan remarks are further isnads or variants, and are not written as routes here
«بإسناده» has no previous report supplied, so it stands as a back_reference
«نحو حديث مالك بمعناه» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group
